N-cone.objects: A0,A1, M+, its gauge and the family F are explicitly named.
N-cone.domain: Finite T>0, real Banach spaces and 1<=p,q<=infinity with the excluded pair spelled out.
N-cone.fixed_and_variable: Spaces, embedding and cone/gauge are fixed; v varies in a uniformly bounded family.
N-cone.hypotheses: Positive definiteness, nonnegative scaling, degree-one homogeneity, gauge-to-A0 bound, compact gauge balls, measurability and both time bounds are visible.
N-cone.equations: Gauge identities and the sum of the Lp gauge and Lq(A1) derivative norms are displayed.
N-cone.quantifiers: Bounds hold uniformly over F; compactness applies to every gauge-bounded sequence; q>1 or q=1,p finite is an explicit disjunction.
N-cone.conclusion: Every trajectory sequence has an Lp(A0)-convergent subsequence; no cone-closedness or stronger-norm conclusion is implied.
N-cone.status: Known Barrett--Suli theorem in the verified v2, with a local replacement of a source proof interface; no novelty asserted.
N-cone.local_definitions: All nonstandard cone axioms are repeated in the principal. Distributional derivatives and essential norms have their assumed Bochner meaning.

scope.evidence_basis: Author rereading and explicit calculation of the fixed-node argument, with source support scoped as recorded. Isolated canonical rereading retains the full cone axioms, fixed continuous injection A0->A1, compact gauge-bounded inclusion, measurable gauge, both uniform norms and exactly the two allowed exponent ranges. It concludes Lp(A0) compactness and explicitly excludes the (infinity,1) endpoint and limit-in-nonclosed-cone inference. The local proof does not rely on the unresolved source passage.
